ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used to create #anchor-links on the page (numbers, letters, hyphens only).

ModalTitle.helper: Enter the modal title to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

ModalTitleIcon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

ModalLead.placeholder: Think of it as a tag line. (Not displayed if empty.)
ModalLead.helper: Enter the modal lead to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

ModalContent.helper: Enter the formatted content for modal content. Keep the text clear and easy to read.

ModalFooterCta.helper: Displayed to the left of the footer close button.

CloseButtonText.helper: Enter the close button text to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

CloseButtonIcon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

Condition.helper: Choose the condition from the available options.

ConditionValue.helper: Should match the value found in the selected condition (not case sensitive).

DelayTime.helper: Delay time, in milliseconds. 5000 would be 5 seconds.

ExitIntentTrigger.helper: Check if you want the pop-up to appear when the visitor attempts to leave the site (a.k.a., Exit Intent).
